mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the prior 6-month average signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressure, pushing firms to raise prices and compress profit margins, which reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5% and continues to decline for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior 6-month average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 0.3% per month signals a rapidly tightening labor market, which increases wage pressure and reduces profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing price index (HOUST) below the prior 6-month average signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction and durable goods spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 0.3% per month combined with a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a rapidly tightening labor market, which increases wage pressure and reduces profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).
